api_key.description: The provider's API key. For Customer.io, an App API key: leave it out to reuse the stored key. For Resend, a full access key: PostHog deletes it when the run ends, so send it every time.

provider.description:
The provider to import from.

* `customerio` - Customer.io
* `resend` - Resend

steps.description: Keys of the steps to run, from the `providers` endpoint. They run in the provider's order, whatever order you send.
